sources.title: Exercise and falls in older adults
sources.abstract: Exercise reduced falls by 30% in a randomized controlled trial of 240 older adults.

sources.title: Balance training in older adults: a pilot study
sources.abstract: Balance training improved balance scores in older adults, although the study was small.

sources.title: Exercise and mortality in frail adults
sources.abstract: In frail adults, exercise reduced mortality by 10% in a single-center trial.

sources.title: Trial design and recruitment
sources.abstract: The trial enrolled 120 participants across two sites.
